notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
List of fixes:

1) Fixed English localization
2) A new soundtrack has been added to the game
3) Added visual acceleration of the ship at the end of the cycle
4) Fixed bugs with save
5) Minor fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 + Added Steam achievements
notes.content:
Steam achievements added to the game! ːsteamhappyː
We continue to refine the game and adjust the balance. 

List of fixes:

1) Fixed interfaces at non-standard screen resolutions
2) Fixed a bug with calculating the results in an automatic battle
3) Changed game modes
4) Changed bonuses for upgrading compartments
5) Changed prices in the virtual market
6) Added a visual warning when there is a shortage of Energy gel
7) Minor fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
1) Fixed a bug due to which, after restarting, the description of resource points did not open.
2) Slightly reduced the amount of resources required for the initial tasks in the campaign.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
1) Fixed a bug with an increase in bonuses on some OS
2) Fixed typos in the texts
3) Fixed incorrect bonuses in events

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
1) Fixed a bug with missing bees at the beginning of a new chapter
2) Added save info at the beginning of a new chapter
